verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner flow (logo, bottle, headline/copy, CTA) with room to breathe. However, the SOLSTICE logo is tiny, the bottle cap jams against the top edge, the body copy is very small and wraps to an orphaned 'sweet.', and the CTA sits awkwardly half over the green circle. B is more readable, but it is badly cramped: both circles are piled into the top-right corner and crowd 'fizz', the oversized CTA nearly touches the right and bottom edges, and the bottle runs almost edge to edge vertically, leaving no breathing room.
